name: nexivo
description: Nexivo Technologies: company website + admin CMS (React, Express, Prisma, MySQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix server run migrate:deploy && npm --prefix server run seed
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run build
